text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research focused on simulating and projecting future land use changes across the entirety of China under eight SSP-RCP scenarios. It uses the FLUS model to generate high-resolution (1 km and 5 km) spatially explicit LULC projections from 2015 to 2100, explicitly reclassified into plant functional types (PFTs) for climate modeling. The study meets all core inclusion criteria: it implements national-scale spatial modeling, has LULC prediction as its primary objective, compares ≥2 future scenarios quantitatively (eight SSP-RCP combinations), reports quantitative validation metrics (FoM values), and produces mapped LULC projections. It does not meet any exclusion criteria—it is not global-only, not local/regional-only, includes explicit future LULC prediction, and outputs spatially explicit maps with accuracy assessment.)
